notes: Prompts mix triggering tests (casual CodeLens frontend phrasings) and output-quality tests (streaming hook with seq dedup + transitions, shared STOMP client, branded IDs + discriminated unions, REST+WS merge, Zod boundary validation). Assertions are objectively checkable. Updated for the session-aware stream, inline diff anchoring, optimistic feedback and Playwright E2E.

evals.prompt: Build the React hook for CodeLens that subscribes to a PR's review topic and shows AI comments appearing word-by-word as they stream in.
evals.expected_output: A hook built on a pure, session-aware state machine: subscribe to review + status topics, buffer live messages until the /app/pr/{id}/replay reply, apply replay then buffered messages; reset state on a newer sessionId; dedup by seq; append fragments by the finding key immutably inside startTransition; unsubscribe on cleanup.

assertions.text: Keys streaming comments on the finding key/fingerprint (not (file, line)) and appends fragments immutably
Drops replayed/duplicate messages by seq and resets lastSeq when a newer sessionId arrives
Requests a replay of missed events after (re)connecting and buffers live messages until it arrives
Wraps high-frequency updates in startTransition
Validates each STOMP message with Zod before applying it
Unsubscribes in the effect cleanup

evals.prompt: Set up the WebSocket/STOMP client for the CodeLens app so it's a single shared connection that reconnects automatically.
evals.expected_output: One Client instance held in a provider via useRef (or a module singleton), activated once with reconnectDelay/heartbeats, shared via context — never recreated per render.

assertions.text: Creates exactly one STOMP client and shares it (context or ref), not one per component/render
Configures reconnectDelay and heartbeats
Uses SockJS as the webSocketFactory
Exposes a connected flag so subscriptions are re-created after reconnects

evals.prompt: Type the CodeLens domain model so a pull-request id can never be passed where a repository id is expected, and so review status is handled exhaustively.
evals.expected_output: Branded string types (PrId, RepoId), a ReviewStatus string-literal union, and exhaustive handling via a never-guard.

assertions.text: Defines branded types for PrId and RepoId
Models ReviewStatus as a discriminated/string-literal union
Handles the union exhaustively with an assertNever / never guard
Does NOT use any to bypass type checking

evals.prompt: When a CodeLens user opens a PR whose review is already in progress, show the comments that were already saved and keep streaming the remaining ones without duplicates.
evals.expected_output: React Query for persisted comments plus the live stream, merged by finding key: while streaming the live set wins but keeps persisted ids/feedback/apply state; when the status leaves IN_PROGRESS the comments/pr/summary/diff queries are invalidated.

assertions.text: Fetches persisted comments via React Query (server cache) separately from the WebSocket stream
Merges persisted and live comments by the finding key without duplicating
Invalidates the comments (and related) queries when the live review completes

evals.prompt: Validate the CodeLens PR-list API response at the boundary so a malformed payload fails loudly instead of producing undefined deep in the UI.
evals.expected_output: A Zod schema parsed in the service layer (schema.parse), with the TypeScript type inferred from the schema via z.infer.

assertions.text: Defines a Zod schema and calls parse (or safeParse) on the response
Infers the TS type from the schema via z.infer rather than hand-writing a duplicate type

evals.prompt: Show CodeLens AI findings directly under the diff line they refer to, in split and unified mode, and still show something useful when we have no diff.
evals.expected_output: A parser producing hunks with absolute old/new line numbers from @@ headers; a table renderer inserting a full-width comment row after the anchored new-file line; findings not in the diff listed separately; a findings-list fallback when the diff is empty; no third-party diff viewer.

assertions.text: Computes absolute line numbers from the hunk headers rather than numbering from 1
Renders each finding in a row immediately after its anchored line
Lists findings whose line is not in the diff separately instead of dropping them
Falls back to a findings list grouped by file when no diff is available

evals.prompt: Add thumbs up/down to CodeLens comments so the count updates instantly, and roll back if the server rejects it.
evals.expected_output: A useMutation with onMutate snapshot + optimistic patch of the comments cache (clicking the active vote clears it), onSuccess writing server counts, onError restoring the snapshot; toggle buttons with aria-pressed; hidden while the comment has no persisted id.

assertions.text: Updates the React Query cache optimistically in onMutate and restores the snapshot on error
Exposes the vote state with aria-pressed on toggle buttons
Does not offer voting on comments that are still streaming / have no id

evals.prompt: Write an end-to-end test that two CodeLens reviewers see each other on the same PR.
evals.expected_output: A Playwright test against the demo-profile backend using saved storage states for Alice and Bob in two browser contexts, opening the PR by number, asserting each sees the other's presence avatar (not their own), a focus marker after hovering a line, and the avatar disappearing after the other context closes.

assertions.text: Uses two separate browser contexts with distinct authenticated storage states
Runs against the real backend (demo profile), not mocked WebSocket messages
Finds the seeded PR by its number rather than a hard-coded database id
Asserts the other user's avatar disappears after their context closes
